{{Quote|Three years after the events of ''The Phantom Menace'', Anakin Skywalker and Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi encounter a mysterious world…|''Rogue Planet'', back cover|<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>}}
'''''Rogue Planet''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel written by [[Greg Bear]]. It is set in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], and follows [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on a mission to [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]. The novel was first published on [[May 2]], [[2000]] by [[Del Rey]].
